label: Maximum annual KiwiSaver government contribution
context: The most an eligible member can receive for a contribution year, which runs from 1 July to 30 June.

label: Own contributions needed for the maximum government contribution
context: A member must put in at least this much of their own money between 1 July and 30 June. Employer contributions, past government contributions and funds moved from Australian retirement schemes do not count.

label: Government contribution for each dollar a member contributes
context: A member who has not saved the full amount still gets this much for every dollar put in between 1 July and 30 June, unless the amount is reduced because they turned 16 or 65, or joined, part-way through the year.

label: Maximum annual taxable income to qualify
context: A member must have an annual taxable income of this amount or less, be contributing to their KiwiSaver account and be aged 16 to 65.

subject_intro: How much the government adds to a KiwiSaver account each year, what a member must put in to get the maximum, and who qualifies.
